caption:
Repositories: abstraction or overhead? A real story — before vs after.

#DotNet #CSharp #EFCore #SoftwareArchitecture

rows.text: A real story from our codebase…

bulletsText: It loaded whole entities (no Select into a DTO)
Mocked tests that proved nothing real
A layer that just forwarded to DbContext
DbSet<T> is the repository, DbContext the unit of work
Tests exercise real SQL with Testcontainers
